title: Settings
subtitle: App preferences and account settings
sectionGitHint: Manage multiple Git accounts; the enabled one writes to git config --global for commits, while Jingling matches history against every account in the list
aboutAppHint: Installed version and host environment (loaded once when opened)
aboutRuntimeHint: Process memory, CPU, and session counts; refreshes about once per second while this page is open
aboutCheckUpdateAria: Manually check for a newer version
dataStorageHint: App data directory and SQLite database path (read-only)
dataClearHint: Clear chats and temporary state. Does not remove accounts, keys, contact info, or registered repos. Confirmation required.
dataClearRestartHint: Some UI preferences fully apply after restart
dataClearAgentChatsHint: Delete all Jingling conversations in project panels and the separate window (including reasoning)
dataClearAgentChatsConfirm: This permanently deletes all Jingling chats. Continue?
dataClearAllHint: Clear all cache items above; accounts, keys, and registered repos are kept
dataClearAllConfirm: This permanently clears Jingling chats and open tabs. Accounts and keys are kept. Continue?
dataBackupHint: Exports include the database, secrets, and preferences — store the file safely. Import overwrites local data.
dataImportConfirm: Import overwrites the local database (after restart), secrets, and preferences. Only import trusted backups.
dataImportRestartHint: Restart JLGit for the database to fully take effect
dataFactoryResetHint: Erase all app data: chats, tabs, preferences, API keys, Git accounts, and registered repositories. Does not delete Git repos on disk or keys under ~/.ssh.
dataFactoryResetConfirm: This permanently clears all in-app data and settings (including registered repos, keys, and chats). Repositories on disk are not deleted. Continue?
gitIdentityAutoSaveHint: Saved automatically once both name and email are filled
gitAccountEmpty: No Git accounts yet — add one to get started
createGitAccountDescription: Name and email are required. The new account is enabled and written to git config --global.
editGitAccountDescription: Update name or email. If this account is enabled, global git config is synced.
gitAccountRequired: Git username and email are required
gitAccountDuplicate: An account with the same name and email already exists
gitAccountNeedOneEnabled: At least one Git account must remain enabled
sshHint: Generate or import a local key; enable one for use. New keys have no passphrase—set one later via edit. Passphrases are not stored in JLGit.
sshAddDescription: Generates an ed25519 key under ~/.ssh (the name is the filename, e.g. id_ed25519 → ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). You may set a passphrase; it is not saved in JLGit.
sshEditPassphraseDescription: Updates the private-key passphrase for “{{name}}” via local ssh-keygen. Passphrases are not stored in JLGit. Leave the new passphrase empty to remove it.
sshPassphraseUnchanged: New passphrase matches the current one; nothing to change
sshKeyRemoved: Removed from list (files on disk kept)
sshKeyDuplicate: This key is already in the list
sshDeleteConfirmGenerated: This will permanently delete the private and public key files for “{{name}}” and remove it from the list. Continue?
sshDeleteConfirmImported: Remove “{{name}}” from JLGit. Files under ~/.ssh will not be deleted (this key was imported). Continue?
apiKeyListHintBefore: Keys saved here power Jingling on this device (chat, commit messages, and more). Create a key in the
apiKeyListHintAfter: , paste it here, and enable only one at a time. Never share keys or commit them to a repo or client code.
apiKeyOpenConsoleFailed: Could not open the DeepSeek console
balanceTip: API calls consume balance. If you have questions,
balanceNeedKey: Add and enable an API key first
createApiKeyDescription: Name and API Key are required. The new key will be enabled automatically.
apiKeyEmpty: No API keys yet. Add one to use 鲸灵.
apiKeyRequired: Enter a name and API Key
editApiKeyDescription: Only the display name changes. The API Key is neither shown nor modified.
commitInstructionsHint: Used by AI to draft commit messages; leave empty for defaults
commitInstructionsPlaceholder: JLGit defaults are used, or write your team rules…
pullRequestInstructionsHint: Used by AI to draft PR titles and descriptions; leave empty for defaults
pullRequestInstructionsPlaceholder: JLGit defaults are used, or write your team PR template…
openMultiRepoAgentHint: Separate window; read-only profiles and skills for registered repos. Sessions isolated from Jingling in the project panel.
launchAtLoginHint: Open JLGit automatically when you log in
launchAtLoginFailed: Could not update launch at login
startupTabsHint: Restore previously open repository tabs, or always start with a single new tab
startupTabsFresh: Always start with a new tab
pushAfterCommitHint: New commits select “Push to remote” by default
alsoInStatusBar: Theme and language can also be toggled from the status bar
